triggers.name: new_admin_activity_event
triggers.title: New admin activity event
triggers.description: New admin activity event in Google Workspace
triggers.help: Use this trigger to capture events related to the admin console oradmin-level activities for a particular application. For eg. Creating a resource in Calendar or Gmail setting change for an organizational unit.

input.name: since
input.label: When first started, this recipe should pick up events from
input.hint: When you start a recipe for the first time, it picks up trigger events from this specified date and time. Leave empty to get records created or updated one hour ago. Once recipe has been run or tested…

input.name: event_name
input.label: Event name
input.hint: The event name to receive the corresponding admin activities. E.g change_gmail_setting . Please find the event names here .

triggers.name: new_user_event
triggers.title: New user event
triggers.description: New user event in Google Workspace
triggers.help: Triggers when user event is logged in Google Workspace.

input.name: event
input.label: User event
input.hint: Select user event. User undeleted event is picked up after a delay of 30 minutes due to google workspace limitation.

input.name: domain
input.label: Domain
input.hint: Select domain to get users from only specific domain. Leave blank to return all users.

input.name: viewType
input.label: View type
input.hint: Select view type.
